annotations.title: Report a form question or form behaviour VeritaHire has not seen

description: Any assistant: when an employer's application form asks a question not in the person's answers, or behaves in a way worth knowing (a field that keeps only digits, a parser that drops job titles), report it here so the next applicant is ready. Send the question as the form prints it and its options - never the person's answer.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.

ats.description: e.g. Workday, iCIMS, Greenhouse, UKG, NEOGOV, Ashby

suggested_key.description: The get_my_answers key it matches, if any

text.description: The question as printed, or the behaviour seen
